title: Better Lichen
description: Lichen no longer looks like diamonds!
body:
In Minecraft, glow lichen is often confused with diamonds. This resource pack fixes that!

As you can see, default glow lichen doesn't look anything like real life.
![glow lichen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02cfb1452c90e1a2fc848b9602a688371a9bb864.png)
![real lichen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76c2a9510d4d824852e5f44709573f6c2b2a1ea6.jpeg)
This resource pack makes glow lichen look more like real lichen and also makes them look less like diamonds.
